name: 19063 · Media, PA
findings: ZIP 19063 (Media) has 243 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19063 (Media) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19063 (Media) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
